verdict.rationale: Google publishes a public GitHub repository, google/google-authenticator, containing OTP generator implementations for several mobile platforms and a linked PAM module, so some product source is readable. The pack never states the license, and nothing shows that the current shipping app (with account sync, Privacy Screen and similar features) is in that repo. Missing for 10: an explicit open-license statement, evidence that the current production app source is published, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The Google Authenticator project includes implementations of one-time passcode generators for several mobile platforms.
These implementations support the HMAC-Based One-time Password (HOTP) algorithm specified in RFC 4226 and the Time-based One-time Password (TOTP) algorithm specified in RFC 6238.
